Why this title: 8 reported developers; ~2 months to soft launch, ~6 months to global launch; 14M downloads and KRW50B+ cumulative revenue by Jul-2025
What to learn: Keep initial core/system set modular and validate early before expanding content breadth
What NOT to copy: Do not assume 8 people handled all ongoing LiveOps UA QA art outsourcing and support

Why this title: 2024 Sensor Tower snapshot: US = 16.5% of downloads but 39.4% of revenue; calculated value-share index 2.39x
What to learn: Treat US as a value market and separate acquisition share from monetization share
What NOT to copy: Do not call share ratio payer rate RPD LTV or current 2026 performance

Why this title: City 7 and Payment Challenge shipped in the same Aug-2026 release train
What to learn: Bundle new ownership/progression content with a clearly instrumented monetization/challenge layer
What NOT to copy: Do not ship area + monetization without persistence/ranking QA gates

Why this title: Major content on Aug20 followed by Aug21 seasonal-ranking fix and Aug31 data-saving fix
What to learn: Plan fast rollback/hotfix live-state migration and save-integrity checks as part of LiveOps cost
What NOT to copy: Do not infer incident severity from patch notes alone

Why this title: Current US App Store surfaces Apple Orchard and Cattery alongside office/city progression
